# Dhruv Patel (@DearDhruv) - Full Content Directory

> A comprehensive, structured index of all technical content, architectural documentation, and production engineering works on deardhruv.com for Large Language Models, AI search crawlers, and developer agents.

## Author & Engineering Profile

- **Name**: Dhruv Patel (known online as **DearDhruv**)
- **Role**: Lead Android & Multiplatform Engineer | Director & Lead Engineer
- **Experience**: 14+ years building high-performance mobile architectures, on-device AI runtimes, and digital commerce platforms
- **Core Specializations**:
  - On-Device AI & LLM Inference (llama.cpp v0.7.0, Google AI Edge LiteRT, Apple MLX, Speculative Turbo decoding)
  - Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) & Compose Multiplatform
  - High-Performance Native Systems (C++20 NDK, Vulkan/OpenCL/Metal compute, ARM KleidiAI vector acceleration)
  - Architecture Patterns (MVI, Clean Architecture, Reactive StateFlow)
  - Cloud Synchronization & Offline-First Data (Cloud Firestore Schema v5, SQLDelight v10)
  - Hardware-Software Integration & Native Crash Isolation (`fork()` process sandboxing)

## Featured Production Systems

### 1. AI Playground
- **Repository**: [https://github.com/DearDhruv/Model-Playground](https://github.com/DearDhruv/Model-Playground)
- **Google Play**: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.deardhruv.llmplayground](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.deardhruv.llmplayground)
- **Tech Stack**: Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform, C++20 / NDK (llama.cpp v0.7.0), Google AI Edge LiteRT, Apple MLX, Vulkan/OpenCL/Metal, SQLDelight
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Dual-model Speculative Turbo decoding (draft pairing, dynamic context capping, KV cache session pre-warming)
  - Multi-runtime orchestration across llama.cpp (Vulkan/OpenCL/KleidiAI CPU), LiteRT-LM, LiteRT 2.3.0 Bonsai 4B diffusion, and Apple MLX
  - Defensive `fork()` child process sandbox with 3000ms watchdog timeout and `kill(pid, SIGKILL)` fallback preventing vendor GPU driver crashes
  - Pure Kotlin Multiplatform document processing engine across 25+ file formats with zero external APIs
  - 100% offline activity ledger (SQLDelight schema v10) with strictly zero network telemetry (`INV-OFFLINE-01`)
  - Streaming mid-generation SQLite persistence (2500ms) with interrupted reply recovery

### 2. VelociHue
- **Google Play**: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.deardhruv.velocihue](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.deardhruv.velocihue)
- **Tech Stack**: Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform, Kotlin 2.4.0, AGP 9.2.1, Target SDK 37 (Android 17), Cloud Firestore (Schema v5), Android TV
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Shared pure-Kotlin game engine (`GameEngine`, `CollisionDetector`, `StatsManager`, `AchievementManager`) running at 60–120 FPS
  - Cloud Firestore schema v5 sync with 3-way union merge strategies for cross-device progression, daily stats, and weekly rolling recaps
  - 29-achievement multi-tiered engine evaluated by single pure-function derived unlock engine (`AchievementUnlockComputation`)
  - Reduced-motion and photo-sensitive safety mode with haptic intensity tuning
  - Android TV 10-foot experience with D-pad navigation and Leanback support
  - High-resolution run summary PNG share card generation via Compose `GraphicsLayer.toImageBitmap()`

## Beyond the Model Engineering Series

1. **Part 1 - I Wanted the Model to Stay on the Phone**
   - URL: [https://deardhruv.com/posts/ai_playground_series/01-i-wanted-the-model-to-stay-on-the-phone/](https://deardhruv.com/posts/ai_playground_series/01-i-wanted-the-model-to-stay-on-the-phone/)

   - Focus: Philosophy, core constraints, runtime landscape, privacy, and battery considerations.

2. **Part 2 - The Day a Chat Box Became a Document Engine**
   - URL: [https://deardhruv.com/posts/ai_playground_series/02-the-day-a-chat-box-became-a-document-engine/](https://deardhruv.com/posts/ai_playground_series/02-the-day-a-chat-box-became-a-document-engine/)

   - Focus: On-device RAG, semantic chunking, embedding generation, and 25+ format document parsing without cloud dependencies.

3. **Part 3 - The Model Was Fine. The Phone Wasn't.**
   - URL: [https://deardhruv.com/posts/ai_playground_series/03-the-model-was-fine-the-phone-wasnt/](https://deardhruv.com/posts/ai_playground_series/03-the-model-was-fine-the-phone-wasnt/)
   - Markdown: [https://deardhruv.com/posts/ai_playground_series/03-the-model-was-fine-the-phone-wasnt/index.md](https://deardhruv.com/posts/ai_playground_series/03-the-model-was-fine-the-phone-wasnt/index.md)
   - Focus: Memory pressure, Android Low Memory Killer (LMK), thermal throttling, dynamic thread scaling, and quantization tradeoffs.

4. **Part 4 - I Put an Image Generator Inside the Phone**
   - URL: [https://deardhruv.com/posts/ai_playground_series/04-i-put-an-image-generator-inside-the-phone/](https://deardhruv.com/posts/ai_playground_series/04-i-put-an-image-generator-inside-the-phone/)

   - Focus: Mobile diffusion synthesis, Google AI Edge LiteRT multi-graph pipelines, Apple MLX Metal GPU execution, and Bonsai 4B memory budgeting.

5. **Part 5 - At Some Point I Stopped Building a Chat App**
   - URL: [https://deardhruv.com/posts/ai_playground_series/05-at-some-point-i-stopped-building-a-chat-app/](https://deardhruv.com/posts/ai_playground_series/05-at-some-point-i-stopped-building-a-chat-app/)

   - Focus: Clean Architecture, MVI presentation layer, runtime boundary contracts, and multiplatform system coordination.

6. **Part 6 - Pushing Mobile Hardware to the Edge**
   - URL: [https://deardhruv.com/posts/ai_playground_series/06-pushing-mobile-hardware-to-the-edge/](https://deardhruv.com/posts/ai_playground_series/06-pushing-mobile-hardware-to-the-edge/)
